Initial release — powerful end-to-end startup metrics command center.

- Supports all company stages (pre-seed to growth) and models (SaaS, marketplace, consumer, hardware+software)
- Metrics architecture guides you from model/stage ID to building a tailored metric stack
- Comprehensive formula reference for revenue, unit economics, churn, growth, cash, and sales
- Includes benchmark guidance, efficiency checks (Rule of 40, Burn Multiple, Magic Number), and actionable thresholds
- Built-in diagnostic framework (PULSE Method) for interpreting and troubleshooting metrics
